description: Permanently disables the key or connection making this call. Cannot be undone; the owner creates a new key or reconnects in Settings. Only this connection's API requests stop, and for a connection made through the consent page (OAuth) the webhooks it created are turned off too; queued posts and cloud patrol settings created with it keep running (with an API key, its webhooks keep running as well). The result lists the confirmation requests this connection was still waiting on, now cancelled. Every later call with it answers 401 key_disabled. A connection made through the consent page of a platform such as claude.ai or ChatGPT is shared by every session of that platform for this member, so disabling it stops all of them until the user reconnects. Applies when the credential may have leaked or the user asks to stop this connection for good.
name: disable_this_key
title: Disable this connection
